welcome.title: Good to have you here.
welcome.hint: We'll ask you a few short questions. After that you'll know where you're at home in CoFoundery.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.hint: This is how you'll appear to other people here.

plan.title: What are you here to do?
plan.hint: This decides which areas open up for you. There's no wrong answer – and none that locks you in.

focus.title: Where's your focus?
focus.hint: A rough direction is enough. It gets more specific on its own.

intention.title: What are you working on right now?
intention.hint: This sets the context for everything you'll meet here.

avatar.title: Want to add a picture?
avatar.hint: Entirely optional. You can do it later any time.

next.title: These are your areas
next.hint: You'll find them in the bar at the top from now on.

onboarding.welcomeText: It takes a minute, and you can change everything later.
onboarding.focusOtherPlaceholder: If you like, describe your focus more specifically here
onboarding.avatarSkipHint: It is completely fine to skip this for now.
onboarding.nonDiagnosticHint: CoFoundery Align is not a personality test. It helps you make collaboration clearer and more resilient early.
onboarding.stepsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {Last step} =1 {One more step} other {# more steps}}

founder.title: I want to found a company
founder.description: You're building something, or you firmly intend to – alone or with a team.

advisor.title: I support founders
advisor.description: You bring experience and work with teams in an advisory role.

both.title: Both
both.description: You're founding yourself and passing on what you've learned at the same time.

connect.title: Just meet people for now
connect.description: You want to see who's around here before committing to anything.

onboarding.planChangeable: Nothing is final: as a founder or advisor you can change this any time in your profile.

align.name: Align
align.text: Here you work out how you work and decide – and how well that fits with someone else. Not a personality test, but a basis for honest conversations.

find.name: Find
find.text: Here you look for people you could found with. You say what you're looking for and what you bring – and see who fits.

connect.name: Connect
connect.text: Here you meet the network: people with what they offer and need, real problems from other people's days – and everything business ideas grow out of.

onboarding.areasLater: You can add the other areas whenever you like – in your profile, with one checkbox.
onboarding.planChangeableConnect: And if you decide to found something later, we'll open up Align and Find – just drop us a line.
onboarding.areasLaterConnect: Align and Find are open to you whenever you want – just get in touch and we'll unlock them.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.help: Optional. You can set it now or change it later in the dashboard.

edit.rolesHelp: The core role for your onboarding is already set. Here you can activate additional modes.
edit.advisorRoleHelp: Use CoFoundery to support founder teams as an advisor as well.
edit.founderRoleHelp: Use CoFoundery for your own founder profile, matching, and alignment.

Suche.label: Searching
Suche.description: You want to see early who collaboration could really work with.

Partner-Match.label: Partner match
Partner-Match.description: You want to clarify fit and differences in a specific co-founder constellation.

Selbsttest.label: Self-check
Selbsttest.description: You first want to understand your own profile and way of working more clearly.
